whyItMatters: Two copies of the same package mean the tree ships code the top-level review never saw, and a patched top-level version can be shadowed by the nested one.
actions: Deduplicate the tree and lift the dependency to the top level where it can be reviewed once.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm package-lock.json no longer carries a lockfile that nests a second copy of a package inside another dependency.
